tools.name: fattureincloud_get_user
tools.description: The Fatture in Cloud user this server is signed in as: id, name and email.

tools.name: fattureincloud_list_companies
tools.description: The companies this sign-in can use, with their id (the company_id of the other tools), name, type, plan, VAT number and tax code. Accountants also see controlled_companies.

tools.name: fattureincloud_get_company_info
tools.description: One company's details: name, email, type, the user's role and permissions in it, and the Fatture in Cloud plan and its limits.

tools.name: fattureincloud_list_clients
tools.description: Clients (Clienti) of a company, paged, with an optional filter.

tools.name: fattureincloud_get_client
tools.description: One client with every field (address, VAT number, defaults, e-invoice code).

tools.name: fattureincloud_list_suppliers
tools.description: Suppliers (Fornitori) of a company, paged, with an optional filter.

tools.name: fattureincloud_get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier with every field.

tools.name: fattureincloud_list_products
tools.description: Products and services (Prodotti e servizi) of a company, paged, with an optional filter.

tools.name: fattureincloud_get_product
tools.description: One product with prices, default VAT, category and stock.

tools.name: fattureincloud_list_issued_documents
tools.description: Issued documents of one type (invoices, quotes, credit notes, ...) of a company, paged. Unpaid invoices: type invoice with q next_due_date is not null. Date range: q date >= '2026-01-01' and date <= '2026-01-31'.

tools.name: fattureincloud_get_issued_document
tools.description: One issued document with its customer, items, payments, totals, e-invoice status (ei_status) and PDF link.

tools.name: fattureincloud_list_received_documents
tools.description: Received documents (expenses, supplier credit notes, delivery notes, self-invoices) of a company, paged.

tools.name: fattureincloud_get_received_document
tools.description: One received document with its supplier, items, payments and totals.

tools.name: fattureincloud_list_cashbook_entries
tools.description: Cashbook (Prima nota) entries of a company between two dates: money in and out, with the linked documents and payment accounts.

tools.name: fattureincloud_list_settings
tools.description: Reference lists of a company that other tools need: vat_types (the vat_id of document items), payment_methods, payment_accounts (for paid payments and cashbook filters), revenue_centers, cost_centers, product_categories, received_document_categories.

tools.name: fattureincloud_get_new_document_info
tools.description: What Fatture in Cloud needs to create a document of one type: numerations and next numbers, templates, default values (default VAT, template, payment method), payment methods and accounts, languages and units. tools.name: fattureincloud_verify_einvoice_xml
tools.description: Check whether an issued document produces a valid e-invoice XML before it goes to the SDI. Returns success or the validation errors.

tools.name: fattureincloud_get_einvoice_rejection
tools.description: Why the SDI rejected an e-invoice: the reason, the e-invoice status, the error code and a suggested solution.

tools.name: fattureincloud_create_client
tools.description: Create a client (Cliente) in a company's registry. Returns the new client with its id.

tools.name: fattureincloud_create_product
tools.description: Create a product or service in a company's catalogue. Returns the new product with its id.

tools.name: fattureincloud_create_issued_document
tools.description: Create an invoice, quote, proforma, receipt, delivery note, credit note or order. It gets the next number unless you give one. tools.name: fattureincloud_send_einvoice
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE: send an issued e-invoice (e_invoice true) to the Italian exchange system SDI. Use only when the user asks to send it. Run fattureincloud_verify_einvoice_xml first; dry_run true checks the send without sending.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "fattureincloud_create_issued_document" is 602 chars, far longer than this server's median (106). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fattureincloud_get_user, fattureincloud_get_company_info · Private data: fattureincloud_list_issued_documents, fattureincloud_get_issued_document, fattureincloud_list_received_documents, fattureincloud_get_received_document, fattureincloud_list_cashbook_entries, fattureincloud_list_settings, fattureincloud_get_new_document_info, fattureincloud_verify_einvoice_xml, fattureincloud_create_issued_document, fattureincloud_send_document_email · Public sink: fattureincloud_get_user, fattureincloud_get_company_info, fattureincloud_create_issued_document, fattureincloud_send_document_email, fattureincloud_send_einvoice · Destructive: fattureincloud_send_einvoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fattureincloud_get_user, fattureincloud_get_company_info · Private data: fattureincloud_list_issued_documents, fattureincloud_get_issued_document, fattureincloud_list_received_documents, fattureincloud_get_received_document, fattureincloud_list_cashbook_entries, fattureincloud_list_settings, fattureincloud_get_new_document_info, fattureincloud_verify_einvoice_xml, fattureincloud_create_issued_document, fattureincloud_send_document_email · Public sink: fattureincloud_get_user, fattureincloud_get_company_info, fattureincloud_create_issued_document, fattureincloud_send_document_email, fattureincloud_send_einvoice · Destructive: fattureincloud_send_einvoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
